name: Parts and the referee
tagline: Turns a carved body into a whole car, makes the build files, and judges it.
what: Adds everything except the body: nose, front and rear wings, wheel supports, wheels, tether guides and the cartridge, and cuts the joints into the body.
Makes the files the team needs to print the parts and mill the body.
Holds the referee: an independent check of the finished car against every rule, measured from the outside like a scrutineer, showing how much room is left on each rule.
The referee shares nothing with the cutter, so one cannot hide the other's mistakes.

log.text: All 3 reference cars pass every check (162 of 162) on the body builder's latest code. Started small trial batches on Codespaces (blackwingstem-wq and blackwinglinkedin-crypto, 4 cores each).

875 trial older-style cars on the body builder's in-progress code all crashed (body pieces not closed). Not counted. Checking its newer fix with 20 cars.
